Only position weighting changes; the existing loss reduction and all training and inference interfaces remain unchanged. Multiplication by `keep.float()` gives padding zero weight. Row normalization gives every nonempty row total weight one, including a single-target row. Targets ten valid transitions apart have a newer-to-older weight ratio of `2**(10/10) = 2`, preserved by normalization. These deterministic algebraic checks consume no RNG state. Validation improvement remains unmeasured.
